version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.03 (English UI) - UI language: all on-screen text, the built-in manual (@about) and the Lua helpers translated to English; helper scripts renamed to "TT-PHALYX Load Kit" / "TT-PHALYX Save Bank" (re-add them once in the action list) 1.02 (polish package) - NEW: tempo sync (SYSTEM tab, slider 63): delay time and/or arp rate follow the project tempo - delay grid 1/16 to 1/1, arp grid 1/4 to 1/32 (each including triplets) - NEW: slim pads draw sample B as a dark ghost contour behind sample A - TONE: chorus with a second voice per channel (quarter-phase offset, medium mod depth); flanger feedback with HF damping (~2.5 kHz one-pole) 1.01 (improvement package) - NEW: arp shuffle 0-50 % (off-beats swing late, SHUF field in the MIDI/ARP tab, automation slider 62) - NEW: pitch bend with per-pad range 0-24 st (smoothed, INPUT box; affects the playback rate in both trigger modes, slider 61) - NEW: root note control (multitrack keytrack base, INPUT box, slider 60) - NEW: MIDI monitor in the status line (pitch bend/CC readout + hit velocity bars per pad) - NEW: predelay 0-250 ms for ROOM/TRASH/GATE (4th parameter) - NEW: clip LED in the header, scratch playhead line, arp markers on the slim pads - FIX: debug counters no longer written into the serialized blobs 1.00 (release) - Manual: @about with a chapter per tab (front, kit, tabs, scratcher, banks/undo, MIDI learn, limits vs. Phalanx) - CPU: the arp scheduler in @sample is skipped while no arp is active (arpAct flag, maintained on start/stop/kill) 0.6.0 - NEW: arpeggiator per pad (UP/DOWN/UP-DN/RND/ROLL, rate 20 ms to 2 s, 1-4 octaves, gate 5-100 %, sample-accurate in @sample) - NEW: scratcher per pad (SCR button + dragging on the waveform while a note is held, or automation slider 53) - NEW: system page (anti-alias Hermite interpolation, incoming transpose +/-24 st, working polyphony limit), preset banks as files (8 slots, load B1-B8), per-pad undo (SNAP/UNDO) - FIX: ROOM reverb was near full scale - output 0.02 -> 0.011, room feedback base 0.78 -> 0.72 0.5.0 - NEW: FX page as master chain: EQ -> 4 insert slots; 4-band EQ (PEAK/LO-SHELF/HI-SHELF/LO-CUT/HI-CUT, RBJ biquads, live response curve); inserts DELAY, CHORUS, FLANGER, PHASER, DISTORT, CRUSH, COMP, LIMIT, ROOM, TRASH, GATE, STEREO 0.4.0 - NEW: 8-row mod matrix, 2 LFOs per pad, mod envelope, GUI modifiers, velocity depth + curve, per-slot panorama 0.3.x - NEW: filter page (LP/HP/BP/notch, 6/12/24 dB, drive clean/dirty), pitch envelope with portamento (OFF/POLY/LEGATO), loop editor (normal/ping-pong/crossfade, zero-cross snap) - FIX: crackle artefacts of the early build removed 0.2.0 - NEW: sample B + crossfade, reverse, start/random offsets, sample delay, phase invert, per-slot LPF/HPF/LoFi/Spike, retrigger, amp envelope editor over the waveform 0.1.x - First playable version: loader (file_riff, resample to project rate, peak cache), 64-voice pool, amp envelope, kit note map, multitrack channels, killnote, crossfade, mute/solo, transpose/fine, slim-pad UI, full panel, tab bar, scope
